answer: Answers are salted with a 145 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the marble salt is published after the nadir checkpoint, the ledge audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 136 keys as a result pays for 136 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
